Elizabeth Mably is a third-year Pandora at West Genetics who was formerly ranked 2nd among all West Genetics third-year students before her temporary retirement. At the beginning of the series, Elizabeth is the second-ranked strongest third-year student from the United Kingdom. Known as the "Academy Reigning Enforcer" (神算鬼謀の執行者 Shinsankibō no Shikkōsha), Elizabeth is the leader of the third-years who maintain the Academy's hierarchy and punish those who break them. She is also known as "The Executor of Ingenious Schemes". And she is also known as "The Empress" (女帝 Jotei) for her stern and strict demeanor which makes her discipline upon her underclassmen and classmates alike. When she hears news of Miyabi Kannazuki's defeat at the hands of Satellizer L. Bridget early in the series, Elizabeth orders Attia Simmons to take care of the matter but was stopped by Chiffon who orders her to stop targeting Satellizer. Her family also runs a winery, along with a famous cosmetics company.
